start.title: [TODO:pl] A Voice in the Night
start.text:
[TODO:pl] The fire in your tent has burned low.
Isaac sleeps beside Sarah — the son of promise, the laughter of your old age.
Then, in the silence, a voice you have known all your life: "Abraham."

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Answer at once: "Here I am"
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] The word leaves you before fear can catch it. "Here I am, Lord."

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Pretend you did not hear
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You pull the blanket higher. The voice does not move on.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Demand to know what He wants first
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Your heart bargains before it has even listened. The silence grows heavier.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] He Does Not Pass By
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] The voice does not leave. It waits — patient, immense, certain.
You cannot run from the One who called you out of Ur.
You rise from the bed and step into the cold air.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Bow low and answer at last: "Here I am"
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You touch your forehead to the sand. "Here I am, Lord."

the_command.title: [TODO:pl] Take Your Son
the_command.text:
[TODO:pl] The words come, slow and terrible:
"Take your son, your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah.
Offer him there as a burnt offering, on a mountain I will show you."

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Refuse — surely God could not ask this
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You shake your head. But the command does not unsay itself.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Bow in trembling silence and accept
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You press your face to the ground. No words come — only surrender.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Beg God to take you instead
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] "Take me, Lord — not the boy." The heavens do not answer the trade.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] The God Who Gave Him
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] You stand alone under the vast stars.
This is the same God who promised Isaac when Sarah's womb was dead.
He gave the boy. He has not lied to you yet.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Trust the One who gave — and obey
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Your refusal collapses. "He who gave can also keep."

bargain_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] No Substitute You Can Offer
bargain_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] Your bargains die in your throat.
This test is not for your life. It is for your heart.
The stars wait above you in their thousands — the very stars He once promised.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Let go of the bargain and obey
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You stop bargaining. There is nothing left but to trust.

the_weight.title: [TODO:pl] Before the Dawn
the_weight.text:
[TODO:pl] You sit by the dying fire until the sky greys.
Isaac breathes softly nearby. Sarah does not stir.
Soon the sun will rise — and you must move before your courage breaks.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Wake the servants and saddle the donkey at once
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Better to walk than to think. You rise and begin.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Wait — perhaps another sign will come
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Dawn comes anyway. The command does not change.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Wake Sarah and tell her everything
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Your hand hovers over her shoulder — and falls back. She would not survive the parting.

delay_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] No Other Sign Will Come
delay_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] The light grows. Birds begin their first calls.
The word once spoken does not need to be repeated.
Obedience delayed will not soften what must be done.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Rise and prepare for the journey
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You stand, stiff with the weight of it, and call the servants.

tell_sarah_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] She Must Not Bear This
tell_sarah_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] She would tear the tent down.
She would cling to Isaac and curse the God who asked.
This burden is yours alone — and Isaac's, if it must be.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Leave quietly and prepare in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You step outside without a word. The dawn keeps your secret.

departure.title: [TODO:pl] Three Days' Walk
departure.text:
[TODO:pl] You split the wood for the burnt offering yourself — each blow of the axe heavier than the last.
You wake Isaac gently. Two servants come with you.
The land of Moriah lies three days to the north.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Set out at first light without explanation
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] The boy follows, sleepy and trusting. You do not look back at the tent.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Lie to Isaac about where you are going
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] The lie tastes of ash. He believes you without question — which is worse.

lie_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] Truth Enough for Today
lie_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] You cannot lie to him. Not the whole truth — but not a lie.
"We go to worship," you tell him. "God will provide."
It is more true than you yet understand.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Walk on with him into the dawn
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] He smiles up at you and takes your hand. The road begins.

the_road.title: [TODO:pl] The Long Road North
the_road.text:
[TODO:pl] Three days under a vast pale sky.
Isaac chatters about lambs and stars and what Sarah will cook when you return.
Every word is a small knife — and a small mercy.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Listen to him fully — store every word
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You drink in his voice as if it were the last well in the desert.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Walk apart and harden your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You quicken your pace ahead of him. The distance does not protect you.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Turn back — claim the journey was a mistake
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Your feet slow. But you cannot outrun the voice that called you.

harden_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] A Father Cannot Harden Himself
harden_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] You cannot make yourself small enough to escape this.
If God provides nothing, you will lose him either way — once on the altar, and forever in your soul.
He deserves your love until the last step.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Slow down and walk beside him again
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You match his pace. He smiles up at you. You do not deserve that smile.

turn_back_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] There Is No Going Back
turn_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] If you turn back now, every promise unravels.
The stars He counted, the nations He swore — all collapse on a refusal.
Faith is a road; you are already on it.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Face north again and keep walking
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You set your face like flint and walk on with him.

mountain_in_sight.title: [TODO:pl] The Mountain Afar Off
mountain_in_sight.text:
[TODO:pl] On the third day you lift your eyes — and see it.
A single peak in the distance, wrapped in pale haze.
Something inside you knows this is the place.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Tell the servants to wait here with the donkey
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] "Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go up to worship — and we will come again to you."

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Bring the servants up with you for support
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You take a step toward them — then stop. They cannot share this.

servants_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] This Is for No Other Eyes
servants_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] If they witness, they will stop you. If they stop you, you have failed Him.
This is between you, the boy, and God.
No other hand may steady or hinder.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Tell them to wait here at the foot of the mountain
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] "Stay here. We will return to you." The words feel like prophecy you do not yet understand.

leave_servants.title: [TODO:pl] He Will Carry the Wood
leave_servants.text:
[TODO:pl] You lay the bundle of split wood across Isaac's strong young shoulders.
You carry the fire and the knife in your own hands.
Together you begin to climb the narrow path.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Walk in silence beside him
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Step by step, the path winds upward. The wind sings in the cliffs.

isaacs_question.title: [TODO:pl] Where Is the Lamb?
isaacs_question.text:
[TODO:pl] Halfway up, Isaac stops and turns to you.
"My father — behold the fire and the wood. But where is the lamb for the burnt offering?"
His eyes are clear and trusting. He waits for an answer.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] "God Himself will provide a lamb, my son"
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] The words leave you like a prayer. Even you do not yet know what they mean.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Tell him the truth — that he is the lamb
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] His face goes white. He drops the wood and stumbles backward.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Say nothing and keep walking
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] He waits a long moment. Then quietly follows. Something in him knows.

tell_truth_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] He Trusts You Still
tell_truth_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] He trembles. But after a long silence, he picks up the wood again.
He does not run. He does not curse you.
He walks on beside you — because he trusts the God you have always trusted.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Walk with him in awed silence to the summit
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Two faiths walk side by side up the last of the path.

silence_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] The Answer of Faith
silence_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] You cannot leave his question without an answer — not now, not ever.
Faith is not silence. Faith is the word spoken into the dark.
You turn to him.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Say: "God Himself will provide the lamb, my son"
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You speak it. The mountain seems to hold its breath.

summit.title: [TODO:pl] The Place He Showed
summit.text:
[TODO:pl] You reach the place. The wind stills.
You begin to gather stones. Isaac kneels and helps you, his small hands beside yours.
The altar rises — rough, sacred, terrible.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Lay the wood in order upon the stones
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Each piece of wood goes down with care. The altar is ready.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Stop — you cannot do this
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Your hands fall to your sides. The wind picks up around you.

stop_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] Faith That Believes Resurrection
stop_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] Your hands shake. Then a thought enters you — older than the command itself:
"He who gave Isaac out of a dead womb can give him back from the dead."
You believe it. You do not understand it. But you believe.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Take up the wood and finish what was begun
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Your hands steady. You complete the altar.

the_binding.title: [TODO:pl] He Did Not Resist
the_binding.text:
[TODO:pl] You turn to Isaac. There are no words — only your eyes meeting his.
He sees. He understands. And he does not run.
He kneels. He lets you bind his hands. He lays himself upon the wood.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Kiss his forehead and lift the knife
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] His tear meets your tear. You raise the knife.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Loose him — flee from the altar
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Your hand finds the cord — but stops. To turn back now is to make all his courage worthless.

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] His Faith Holds You
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] The boy lies still beneath you, eyes closed, breathing steady.
He trusts. He is offering himself with you.
If you flee, you betray not only God — but Isaac's own surrender.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Stand with him to the end — lift the knife
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You raise the knife above him, both hands trembling.

the_knife.title: [TODO:pl] Abraham! Abraham!
the_knife.text:
[TODO:pl] The blade rises high. Your arms are stone.
At the highest point — a voice tears the sky open:
"Abraham! Abraham!"

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Answer at once: "Here I am"
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] The knife stops. "Here I am, Lord."

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Strike before another command can come
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Your arm tenses — then locks. You cannot. The voice has the right of way.

strike_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] The Test Is Not Blood
strike_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] Your arm will not move.
God did not ask for the death — He asked for the heart that would give the death.
You have given Him that heart. The blade has done its work already.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Lower the knife and answer the voice: "Here I am"
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] The knife falls from your hand into the dust. "Here I am."

the_stay.title: [TODO:pl] Lay Not Your Hand on the Boy
the_stay.text:
[TODO:pl] "Lay not your hand on the boy. Do nothing to him.
For now I know that you fear God — for you have not withheld your son, your only son, from Me."
You drop to your knees beside him. The world breathes again.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Loose Isaac's hands and lift him from the wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Your trembling fingers free him. He clings to you and weeps.

the_ram.title: [TODO:pl] Caught in the Thicket
the_ram.text:
[TODO:pl] You lift your eyes — and there in the brush behind the altar, a ram stands caught by its horns in the thicket.
It did not come from the path. It is simply there.
God has provided.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Take the ram and offer it in Isaac's place
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You free the ram and lay it on the wood. The fire rises.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Refuse — sacrifice nothing now
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You stand frozen. The ram waits. The altar waits.

no_sacrifice_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] Worship Must Be Completed
no_sacrifice_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] You came to worship. The altar still calls for an offering.
God has provided one — to receive it is the final act of obedience.
Not to offer it is to despise the mercy.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Take the ram and complete the offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You free the ram and lay it on the wood. The smoke rises straight to heaven.

the_name.title: [TODO:pl] The Lord Will Provide
the_name.text:
[TODO:pl] You name the place Yahweh-Yireh — "The Lord Will Provide."
Isaac stands beside you, alive, breathing, his hand small in yours.
The smoke of the ram rises into the wide pale sky.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Bow and listen — the voice is not finished
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You bow your head. The voice comes again, gentler this time.

the_blessing.title: [TODO:pl] By Myself I Have Sworn
the_blessing.text:
[TODO:pl] "By Myself I have sworn, says the Lord:
because you have done this and have not withheld your only son,
I will surely bless you, and multiply your seed as the stars of the heaven and as the sand upon the seashore.
In your seed shall all nations of the earth be blessed — because you have obeyed My voice."

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Take Isaac's hand and begin the long walk home
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] You turn together toward the path, the sky burning gold around you.

homecoming.title: [TODO:pl] We Have Come Again
homecoming.text:
[TODO:pl] You walk down the mountain together as the stars begin to show themselves.
The servants are waiting where you left them.
"We have come again to you," you say — and it is truer than they will ever know.
